news.analysis: Nix threw touchdowns to Courtland Sutton and Pat Bryant, including a 26-yard score to the latter in the fourth quarter. The Broncos quarterback has now thrown six touchdowns over his last three games. That said, Nix has been less productive on the ground since his 74-yard rushing performance in Week 7. Denver gets a Week 10 bye before facing the Raiders in Week 11.

news.analysis: The Eagles took a chance on starting Milton on Sunday, but it didn't go very well. He failed to score a touchdown over the course of the game and led Philadelphia to just 11 points as a team, but he did lead the team with 64 rushing yards, which helped pad his fantasy total on the day. It will be hard to trust starting anyone on Philadelphia's offense for as long as Milton remains their starter.

Half of his fantasy production came on the ground, and with the Eagles' bye in Week 10, Milton should have more opportunities to get reps with the starting offense and host the Pittsburgh Steelers in Week 11.
